layout.notebook_first:
All systems are green. The engines only need the captain's card. The captain went down to the engine room and never came back.
If you are reading this, the dog tag got you off the bridge too. What you carry decides where a door leads.

notes.text: You won't find the gyroscope unless you carry the family photo. Don't ask me how I know.
The pressure gauge only shows up for someone carrying the family photo and the gyroscope.
Don't waste a slot on the ration tin.
You won't find the pressure gauge unless you carry the family photo and the gyroscope. Don't ask me how I know.
Carried the voice recorder through a dozen doors. Nothing changed. Drop it.
Engines. The family photo, the gyroscope, the pressure gauge. Nothing else but this notebook. Drop the dog tag when the time comes.
I carried the dog tag and the sealant can through a door. The room behind it nearly killed me.
The engine room answers to three things: the family photo, the gyroscope and the pressure gauge. Keep the notebook. The dog tag has done its job. Let it go.
I walked these rooms for hours before I got it. Carry the pressure gauge and the doors let you go.
Take his card. Keep the notebook and the card, nothing else. Remember how you got to the bridge.
Carried the coolant valve through a dozen doors. Nothing changed. Drop it.
Don't waste a slot on the ration tin.
